limitations.claim: Real binding means real pure classifier, own-solve predicate and commit coordinator with scripted ports.
limitations.limit: It does not execute readCommandUi, awaitCommandUi or assertPageOwnRoundSolve against a DOM. Actual selectors, ARIA/version attributes, Playwright polling and row extraction first execute in upcoming real browser lanes.

limitations.claim: DOM adapter inspects one scoped panel, busy/version and exact pending control; own-solve adapter verifies a round-captioned scorecard, same-context alias and solved row.
limitations.limit: Pure-state tests do not certify selector stability, aria propagation, live scheduling or arbitrary aliases. Existing generated aliases and actual browser assertions must supply that evidence; no general DOM coverage is claimed.

limitations.claim: Matrix logical call waits for fresh preparation, validates initial request, retires explicit409, and exact-payload checks uncertain retries within the existing12 attempts.
limitations.limit: Acknowledgement hooks are optional for backward compatibility with58 prior cases; that older test pass does not prove all callers use hooks. Current two live adapters were inspected to supply the new hooks. No increased timeout or weakened game assertions was observed.

limitations.claim: Sender retirement precedes command return; intended answer and profile are checked; current-round same-context solved state precedes solve increment.
limitations.limit: Completed JSON alone is no longer counted. Native actual2..15matrix at the successor frozen head is still required; focused124 cases and old fdee build cannot establish a completed revised matrix.

limitations.claim: Strict generic command and answer helpers use preparation/acknowledgement; unresolved pending is rejected;4-conflict answer bound and push/read/suppression/privacy assertions remain.
limitations.limit: This is source inspection of the adapter, not an executed strict journey. The source-check/adoption diff and focused unit tests are not private-push, renewal, reconnect or observer capacity evidence.

limitations.claim: New successful-classification observations correlate player, logical action and UUID IDs with response/rendered versions and pending/busy state.
limitations.limit: Rejected classifier probes fail before observation callback, so records are not a complete denied/malformed-state history. No browser start/header/completion/abort timestamps or server spans are added. They cannot retroactively identify the old fdee page7request or explain11.6s latency.

limitations.limit: No application responsiveness or latency cause fix is established. Current operational latency, pool/lock/CPU attribution and user-visible recovery behavior remain qualified until next actual browser evidence and optional owned-runtime observations. No new HTTP SLA or timeout/cap/pool/worker increase is authorized.
